texts.title: Raiders on the Lanes
texts.body: The lanes around the house's holdings have gone bad. Freighters arrive late, or light, or not at all, and the ones that do carry a polite note naming a price for the next run. No fleet has been seen in the region for a season. The raiders know it; so does everyone who ships through it.

choices.pay_the_toll: Pay the toll and call it a convoy fee.
choices.arm_the_freighters: Put guns on the freighters and veterans behind them.
choices.hire_the_raiders: Buy the raiders. Better they fly your colours than no one's.

texts.title: A World in Revolt
texts.body: A world of {self.house} has stopped paying. The governor's writ ends at the palace gate; beyond it the square is full every night and the tithe-houses are shuttered. The region has not loved the Core in years and does not love the house now. Nothing comes off that world until the rising ends — by gift, by steel, or by a fleet in orbit.

choices.concede: Go down to the square unguarded. Forgive the tithe. Make councillors of the ringleaders.
choices.break_them: Give the order. The square will be quiet by morning.
choices.wait_for_the_fleet: Send for the fleet and wait. A garrison ends a rising.

texts.title: Whispers of Secession
texts.body: A delegation from the region's towns waits in the hall: merchants, a guild-master, two priests and a very old soldier. They have come to say what everyone already knows. The region holds {self.house} in a way it has never held the Core, and if the house were to declare a Free March tonight the squares would fill in its favour. The Core would not forget it. Neither would the region, either way.

choices.declare_the_march: Stand on the balcony and say the words.
choices.stay_loyal: Send them home with gifts and a refusal.
choices.keep_them_guessing: Promise the region everything and the Core nothing.

texts.title: The Court Convenes
texts.body: The capital is {self.house}'s, and the capital is where the Reach comes to be seen. Envoys, petitioners, cousins and creditors fill the marble halls, each with a request and a gift of carefully calculated size. To hold court costs coin and buys influence. To close the doors keeps the coin and buys something else.

choices.hold_court: Hold court. Let them come and be heard.
choices.close_the_doors: Close the doors. Keep the coin.

texts.title: The Rim Remembers
texts.body: The house's seat is on the Rim, where the lanes end and the law thins. Out here a lord is a rumour unless they come in person, and a tithe is an insult unless it is collected by someone who has shared the hall's bread. The season is right for a ride along the frontier; the ledger says a steward would do.

choices.ride_out: Ride the frontier yourself. Sleep in their halls.
choices.send_a_steward: Send a steward with a ledger.

texts.title: The Enemy's Envoy
texts.body: An envoy from the house {self.house} is at war with waits in the antechamber under a flag of parley. The terms are in a sealed case; the smile is unsealed. To hear him is to admit the war could end on someone else's words; to refuse him is to say it will end on yours; and the man himself, it is whispered, has a price.

choices.hear_terms: Hear the terms. Send him back with wine and no answer.
choices.send_him_back: Read the terms aloud to the household, then burn them.
choices.buy_him: Buy the envoy. Have a friend at the enemy's table.

texts.title: The Knife Traced Home
texts.body: The assassin is dead and the household is counting its blessings, but the steward has done more than count. A seal on the hilt, a letter in a lining, a payment through a counting-house that keeps records: the knife has been traced to a house, and {self.name} now holds a proof that could be read aloud in the chamber, kept for a better day, or answered in the only language its senders respect.

choices.name_them: Lay the proof before the chamber and name them.
choices.keep_the_proof: Keep it. A proof is worth most on the day it is needed.

texts.title: The Coalition Gathers
texts.body: The envoys of four houses have taken the same inn on the same world and are not pretending otherwise. The rise of {self.house} has frightened them into each other's company. {self.name} can break the seam before it sets, show them the fleet and let fear do the rest, or give them something large enough to send them home satisfied and the house diminished.

choices.divide_them: Find the weakest seam and pay for it.
choices.show_strength: Hold a fleet review within sight of their envoys.
choices.bend: Concede something they can see from orbit.
